title: Character Sketch And Biography Of Mrs. Fania Godkin Nee

page_data.en:
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch Station.
REPORT
Date February 14, 1938.
Subject Mrs. F. Godkin - communication from British Consulate-General
dated 8.1.38.
Made by D.C. Henchman Forwarded by

Mrs. Sonia Godkin nee Agkoff was born of Russian
Jewish parents in Odessa on 20th January, 1906. During
the Great War she went with her parents to Harbin and
from thence to Shanghai where she met Mr. J. D. Godkin to
whom she was subsequently married. There is one child,
a son, Josef, aged 6 years.

Her husband, J. D. Godkin, was born in Melitopol
in 1901 and was educated in Harbin and Shanghai. He has
been employed with various trading companies since 1920
and was stationed, while in the employ of the Standard Oil
Company, in Kiukiang and Harbin.

From 1935 Godkin operated his own company, a concern
which dealt in oils and fats. As a result of the recent
hostilities his business in Shanghai suffered a severe
setback and he was forced to seek employment elsewhere,
eventually joining the staff of the travel and tourist
agency of Orient Lloyd, 13 Sara Road. This agency besides
its travel business is suspected of being concerned in the
drug traffic and of arranging for the emigration of Russian
Jews to South America.

In 1930 Mr. and Mrs. Godkin are reported to have
visited Palestine where Mr. Godkin's mother has resided
for several years. It is stated that Godkin now desires
to visit on behalf of his employers, both Singapore and
Soerabaja.

There is nothing in Police records to the detriment
of either Mr. or Mrs. Godkin, both of whom are registered
with Russian Emigrants' Committee in Shanghai.

D.C. (Special Branch)
〔此处转录不清〕
D. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股。
报告
日期：1938年2月14日。
事由：F. Godkin 夫人——英国总领事馆1938年1月8日来函。
撰写人：警佐 Henchman 转呈人：

Sonia Godkin 夫人，娘家姓 Agkoff，于1906年1月20日出生于敖德萨，父母均为俄罗斯犹太人。大战期间，她随父母前往哈尔滨，随后又来到上海，在那里结识了 J. D. Godkin 先生，并与之结婚。育有一子，名为 Josef，现年6岁。

其丈夫 J. D. Godkin 于1901年出生在梅利托波尔（Melitopol），在哈尔滨和上海接受教育。自1920年以来，他受雇于多家贸易公司；在任职于美孚石油公司（Standard Oil Company）期间，曾被派驻九江和哈尔滨。

从1935年起，Godkin 经营自己的公司，这是一家从事油脂生意的企业。由于近期的战事，他在上海的生意遭受严重挫折，迫使他另谋职业，最终加入了位于萨拉路13号的东方劳埃德（Orient Lloyd）旅行社的员工队伍。该机构除了经营旅行业务外，还被怀疑参与毒品交易，并安排俄罗斯犹太人移民南美洲。

据报，Godkin 夫妇曾于1930年访问巴勒斯坦，Godkin 先生的母亲已在那里居住数年。据悉，Godkin 现在希望代表其雇主访问新加坡和泗水（Soerabaja）。

警方档案中没有任何不利于 Godkin 先生或夫人的记录，两人均在上海俄罗斯难民委员会登记注册。

特务科警佐

D. S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

Section 1, Special Br. **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date December 9, 1937

Subject Joseph David Godkin : communication dated December 2, 1937,
from the Netherlands Consulate-General.
Made by J. S. Larby Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Joseph David Godkin, who has applied to the Nether-
lands Consulate-General for a visa to permit him to visit
the Netherlands Indies, is a Russian emigrant of Jewish
extraction.

Born in Melitopol, South Russia, on September 15,
1901, Godkin received his education in Harbin and subsequent-
ly in Shanghai where he has resided since the year, 1915.

During his residence in Shanghai, Godkin, who is
registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, has
operated an animal oil and fat refinery located at 47,
Chining Road. Prior to October, Godkin also maintained
an office styled the Cathay Trading Company at 89, Nanking
Road. This office was used by Godkin to deal with the
export branch of his business.

As a result of the local Sino-Japanese hostilities
his business suffered a very severe setback with the result
that Godkin was obliged to seek a new position and eventually
joined the staff of the Orient Lloyd Ltd., a travel,
tourist, shipping and insurance agency, located at 13,
Ezra Road. Besides conducting the usual routine of a
travel agency, the Orient Lloyd is reported to have
arranged for the emigration of Russian refugees especially
those of Jewish extraction to South America. This
concern has also been suspected of being concerned with
the smuggling of drugs.

报告
日期：1937年12月9日

事由：Joseph David Godkin：荷兰总领事馆1937年12月2日来函。
撰写人：J. S. Larby 转呈人：**〔此处转录不清〕**

Joseph David Godkin 已向荷兰总领事馆申请签证，以便前往荷属东印度群岛，他是一名犹太裔俄罗斯移民。

Godkin 于1901年9月15日出生于俄罗斯南部的梅利托波尔（Melitopol），在哈尔滨接受教育，随后在上海就读，自1915年起一直居住在上海。

在上海居住期间，Godkin 已在上海俄罗斯难民委员会登记，并经营一家位于济宁路47号的动物油脂炼油厂。在10月之前，Godkin 还在南京路89号设有一个名为“华夏贸易公司”（Cathay Trading Company）的办事处。Godkin 利用该办事处处理其业务的出口部门事务。

由于当地中日敌对行动，他的生意遭受了非常严重的挫折，导致 Godkin 不得不寻找新的职位，并最终加入了位于爱兹拉路13号的东方劳埃德有限公司（Orient Lloyd Ltd.）的员工队伍，该公司是一家从事旅行、旅游、航运和保险业务的代理机构。据报道，东方劳埃德除了开展旅行社的常规业务外，还安排了俄罗斯难民，特别是犹太裔难民移民南美洲。该公司也被怀疑参与毒品走私。

It is reported that Godkin intends to visit both
Singapore and Soerabaya on behalf of the Orient Lloyd,
stopping for approximately three weeks at each of the
aforementioned ports. The Singapore Agency of the
Orient Lloyd is known as the American Lloyd, no information
of any agency in Soerabaya however appears to be available.
Of Godkin's activities in Shanghai, nothing is
known to his detriment by the Municipal Police.

A. S. Hardy.
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch)

据报，Godkin 打算代表东方劳埃德公司访问新加坡和泗水（Soerabaya），在上述每个港口停留约三周。东方劳埃德在新加坡的代理机构被称为“美国劳埃德”（American Lloyd），但似乎没有关于其在泗水的任何代理机构的信息。
就 Godkin 在上海的活动而言，工部局警务处并未掌握任何对其不利的情况。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.4014.                                        SHANGHAI, December 2nd, 1937.

Sir,

      I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Joseph
I. GODKIN has applied to this Consulate General for a visé
for admission into the Netherlands Indies.
      He is in possession of a certificate of Registration
issued by the local Bureau of Public Safety at August 28, 1934,
valid till August 28, 1935 and extended till October 1936.
      However, he will apply for a Chinese passport with the
Bureau of Foreign affairs.
      According to his statement he was born at Melitopol
at September 15, 1901, and is connected with the Orient Lloyd
at 13 Ezra Road. He resides in Shanghai since 1915 and stated
furthermore that he has been with the Special Police (No.978).
      He intends to visit the Netherlands Indies for business
purposes.
      His residence is at 30 Nanyang Road, House No.II.
      I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me
know, if possible, whether anything is known against this person
from a political or moral point of view.

                                              I have the honour to be,
                                                       Sir,
                                              Your obedient servant,

（批：S.J. / 2/12）                         （签名）
                                            Act. Consul-General.
                                            （印：SPECIAL BRANCH / - 2 DEC. 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

The Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
        SHANGHAI.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

编号 4014。                                        上海，1937年12月2日。

先生：

      谨此通知阁下，Joseph I. GODKIN 先生已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度群岛的签证。
      他持有由本地公安局于1934年8月28日签发的登记证，有效期至1935年8月28日，并延期至1936年10月。
      然而，他将向外交部申请中国护照。
      据其陈述，他于1901年9月15日出生于梅利托波尔，并与爱兹拉路13号的东方劳埃德公司有关联。他自1915年起居住在上海，并进一步声称他曾隶属于特别警察队（编号978）。
      他打算因公务目的访问荷属东印度群岛。
      他的住址是南阳路30号，11号房屋。
      如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度来看，是否有任何针对此人的不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

                                              此致，
                                                       先生，
                                              您顺从的仆人，

（批：S.J. / 12/2）                         （签名）
